name: loop-virtuoso
description: Deterministic, backlog-driven autonomous execution loop. Feeds an agent one small backlog item at a time and gates completion on objective verify-command exit codes and a write-boundary guard, never on the agent's own self-report. Also ships opt-in guard hooks (secrets, test edits, stop gate), a settings hardener, a setup audit, evals of the setup against vanilla Claude Code, and a self-improvement loop that records signals during runs and turns them into reviewed, commit-ready learnings.
